From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@opaltech.com>

Cc: security@opaltech.com
Date: 2026-01-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Audit orientation & log transfer — request

Hi Jasmine,

We heard from procurement that Redwood will be supporting OpalTech's upcoming vendor security assessment (SOC 2 scoped). Before our formal questionnaire, our security team would like to run a short orientation to confirm expectations and handoff logistics for log samples and questionnaire evidence.

High-level asks:
- 30–45 minute orientation call to review the types of logs you can provide (application access logs, API request logs, admin audit trails, system auth logs), retention windows, and redaction policies.
- Temporary secure transfer for sample logs (we prefer a presigned S3 URL or SFTP) and a checklist of required fields.
- Confirmation on who at Redwood will sign an audit NDA and who will be the technical contact.

Our availability next week is: Tues 2026-01-13 between 10:00–14:00 PT or Wed 2026-01-14 between 09:00–12:00 PT. If those windows don't work, propose a time.

Thanks — looking to keep this lightweight.

Tom Nguyen
Security Lead, OpalTech

Thanks Tom — happy to set this up. Kimberly (security/compliance) and Marissa (Customer Success) are looping in to cover the technical handoff and timing.

We can do Tue 2026-01-13 at 11:00 PT — I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm. A few quick answers so the call is focused:
- Log types: we can provide API request logs (timestamp, request_id, path, status_code), auth/audit trails (user_id, action, timestamp), and system event logs (host, process, timestamp).
- Retention: primary retention is 90 days on hot storage, 1 year on cold archive (we can export samples beyond 90d on request).
- Redaction: PHI/PII is redacted by default from exported samples; we can provide an unredacted dev-only sample under NDA if needed for forensics.
- Transfer: we prefer presigned S3 links for single uploads; we will provide IP allowlist and presigned PUT.

I've attached a quick Log_Specs.xlsx and an S3_transfer_checklist.pdf to show the fields and the upload process. Kimberly will follow up on the NDA formalities — we have a standard partner NDA that moves fast.

Agenda suggestion for the 30-min call:
1) Confirm desired log types and retention window
2) Walk through S3 presigned upload process and IP allowlist
3) Timelines for sampling and any redaction/PII concerns
4) Next steps and owners

If that works, confirm Tue 11:00 PT and we'll lock it.

— Jasmine Liu
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com

- For API request logs, can you confirm whether request bodies are present in the export or if only metadata/headers are captured? Our team will need bodies for a small sample where payloads drive authorization decisions.
- For auth/audit trails, can you map the event names to our SIG question bank (eg: user.login, token.revoked, role.update) — a short mapping table is helpful.
- For the presigned S3 approach, could Redwood provide an IP allowlist and a TTL for the presigned PUT (we usually ask for 24–72 hours)?
- We'll need an executed NDA before we accept any unredacted samples. Please send over the NDA link/DocuSign and the name of the signer.
